daemon_user.description: System user account under which the iWatch daemon runs (must have read permissions on monitored paths).

daemon_group.description: System group for the daemon process.

pid_file.description: Full path to the PID file used for daemon control.

log_file.description: Full path to log file; empty string means use syslog.

scan_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between periodic filesystem scans (use 0 to disable fallback polling).

use_inotify.description: Enable inotify-based real-time monitoring. Disable only for legacy or debugging use.

max_files.description: Maximum number of files and directories to monitor simultaneously.

xmlrpc_enabled.description: Enable XML-RPC interface for remote configuration and status queries.

xmlrpc_bind_address.description: IP address to bind XML-RPC service to (use 0.0.0.0 to allow remote access — not recommended for production).

email_to.description: List of recipient email addresses for alerts.

smtp_server.description: SMTP server hostname or IP to use for sending emails.

smtp_port.description: SMTP server port (typically 25, 465 for SSL, or 587 for STARTTLS).

path.description: Absolute path of directory to monitor (e.g., /var/www/html).

events.description: Filesystem events to monitor (e.g., file creation, deletion, rename).

alert_email_enabled.description: Enable per-watch email alerts (overrides global email config).

alert_email_to.description: Recipient list for this watch's alerts.

use_regex.description: Use regular expressions instead of shell globs for include/exclude patterns.

include_patterns.description: List of filename patterns to include (files matching any pattern are monitored).

exclude_patterns.description: List of filename patterns to exclude (files matching any pattern are ignored).

on_event_script.description: Path to a script to execute when an event occurs (passive events: filename and event type passed as arguments).

max_depth.description: Maximum subdirectory depth to monitor (0 = unlimited).

ignore_self.description: Ignore events triggered by the script/process itself (prevents recursion loops).

watches.description: List of directories to monitor, each with its own rule set.
